title: Add capability index projection
purpose: Expose AgentOS operational capabilities as a read-only catalog projection.
scope: Define capability index over built-in workflows and installed AOM artifacts.
Include service recovery, package install, untrusted content, rootfs update, support bundle and AOM activation preview capabilities.
Show capability authority path and required approvals.
Mark unavailable or degraded capabilities explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Every capability shows launch path as intent or preview.
Unavailable capabilities show reason and source.
Catalog does not duplicate planner or resolver logic.
failure_modes: Catalog hides required approval or rollback.
Catalog encodes AOM resolver logic in TUI.
